            circles[i][1] = ni();

                    double y = circles[i][1] + circles[i][2] * Math.sin(angle);
                    points.add(new double[]{x, y});
                }
            }

        List<double[]> uniquePoints = new ArrayList<>();
        for (double[] pt : points) {
            boolean isDuplicate = false;
            for (double[] existing : uniquePoints) {
                double dx = pt[0] - existing[0];
                double dy = pt[1] - existing[1];
                if (dx * dx + dy * dy < 1e-12) {
                    isDuplicate = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!isDuplicate) {
                uniquePoints.add(pt);
            }
        }

        int nodeCount = uniquePoints.size();
        int edgeCount = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int count = 0;
            for (double[] pt : uniquePoints) {
                double dx = pt[0] - circles[i][0];
                double dy = pt[1] - circles[i][1];

            edgeCount += count;

        out.println(edgeCount - nodeCount + 2);

    private static final double EPS = 1e-10;

    public static double[] computeIntersectionAngles(long x1, long y1, long r1, long x2, long y2, long r2) {
        long dx = x2 - x1;
        long dy = y2 - y1;
        long d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
        long diff = Math.abs(r1 - r2);
        long sum = r1 + r2;

        if (d2 < diff * diff || d2 > sum * sum) {
            return new double[0];
        }

        double distance = Math.sqrt(d2);
        if (distance == 0) {
            return new double[0];
        }

        double baseAngle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
        double angleOffset = Math.acos((d2 + r1 * r1 - r2 * r2) / (2 * distance * r1));

        return new double[]{baseAngle - angleOffset, baseAngle + angleOffset};
    }
